case_name: Shri Ramesh Chand Rai, Indore vs The Cit(A)-3, Bhopal, Bhopal
facts_of_case: Appeals filed by the Revenue and cross appeals filed by the Assessee for Assessment Year 2010-11 to 2016-17 against the Common Order of the Ld. Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals)-3, Bhopal.

legal_principles.principle: All sales under licenses for the sale of country liquor or for the retail sale of intoxicating drugs shall be for cash only.
legal_principles.held: As per Rule XV of General License Conditions under Other Madhya Pradesh Rules under the Madhya Pradesh Excise Act, 1915, all sales under licences for the sale of country liquor or for the retail sale of intoxicating drugs shall be for cash only, and such cash shall be paid over at the time of sale only.
applicable_acts_sections: Madhya Pradesh Excise Act, 1915 — Rule XV

legal_principles.principle: A liquor contractor may hold several licenses for retail sale of liquor in various areas through various shops.
legal_principles.held: Such sales are effected by the salesmen deputed on each shop by the liquor contractor Shri Ramesh Chandra Rai, Ratlam AY 2010-11 to AY 2016-17 himself.

outcome.final_order: The appeals are directed against the Common Order of the Ld. Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals)-3, Bhopal.

use_for_drafting: drafting land acquisition cases in Indore and Bhopal
preparing virtual hearing arguments for IT(SS)A cases
understanding ACIT procedures in Central-1, Ratlam Bhopal
